## Discovery & Translational Science

* **Semaglutide demonstrates broad anti-aging and metabolic benefits in preclinical models** — *[Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/glp-1-drugs-aging)*
  * Administration of semaglutide to 20-month-old aging mice significantly reduced age-associated systemic inflammation and markers of cellular senescence.
  * The GLP-1 receptor agonist improved genomic stability, mitochondrial stress response, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, unfolded protein response (UPR) pathways, adaptive immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

* **β-arrestin-biased NTSR1 modulator SBI-553 suppresses appetite without Gq-mediated toxicity** — *[bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.30.748142)*
  * In diet-induced obese mice, SBI-553—a β-arrestin-biased positive allosteric modulator of neurotensin receptor 1 (NTSR1)—selectively reduced high-fat diet intake and blunted weight regain.
  * By bypassing classical Gq pathway activation, SBI-553 avoided common NTSR1-associated adverse side effects while maintaining hunger-induced refeeding suppression.

* **Myocyte Nfe2l1 identified as key regulator of muscle proteostasis and insulin sensitivity** — *[bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.04.20.537611)*
  * Loss of myocyte Nuclear factor erythroid derived 2-like 1 (Nfe2l1/Nrf1) impaired proteasomal activity, resulting in hyperubiquitylation and muscle fiber type switching in preclinical models.
  * Targeted Nfe2l1 deletion induced skeletal muscle insulin resistance and heightened susceptibility to lipid-induced ferroptosis under high-fat diet conditions.

* **Multiplexed FRET-FLIM imaging predicts atezolizumab response in urothelial carcinoma** — *[medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.01.26361904)*
  * Using the QF-Pro FRET-FLIM assay on pre-treatment tissue microarrays, baseline PD-1/PD-L1 interaction state predicted longer progression-free survival in male patients treated with atezolizumab.
  * Conversely, higher pre-treatment engagement of CTLA-4/CD80 was associated with reduced clinical benefit from PD-L1 blockade.

* **Gene-edited pig kidney recipients successfully transition to human allotransplants** — *[STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/03/recipients-of-gene-edited-pig-kidneys-receive-human-organs/)*
  * Two patients who previously received xenotransplants of gene-edited pig kidneys successfully underwent subsequent human kidney allotransplantation.
  * The milestone supports the viability of gene-edited xenografts as a transient bridge to human organ transplantation.

* **Genetic study links dual Lp(a) and LDL-C lowering to reduced CAD risk** — *[X / @Prof_Oak_](https://x.com/Prof_Oak_/status/2095626246587559971)*
  * Human genetic analysis indicates that combined lowering of Lp(a) and LDL-C achieves a stronger reduction in coronary artery disease (CAD) risk (OR 0.70) than lowering either trait individually (OR 0.85 for Lp(a) alone; OR 0.81 for LDL-C alone).
  * Among statin users, Lp(a) reduction maintained a linear association with decreased CAD risk, providing mechanistic support for clinical-stage Lp(a) programs at Ionis, Arrowhead, and Silence Therapeutics.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **AbbVie reports early 1st-line NSCLC response rates for RC148 (ABBV-1480)** — *[X / @JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2095494885948174697)*
  * RC148 (ABBV-1480) plus chemotherapy demonstrated an overall response rate (ORR) of 90% in 1st-line squamous NSCLC, reaching 93% in patients with PD-L1 < 1% in data slated for #WCLC26.
  * In non-squamous NSCLC, the combination generated an ORR of 76% overall and 71% in PD-L1 < 1% patients.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **Ultragenyx drops GTX-102 after Phase 3 failure in Angelman syndrome** — *[BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ultragenyx-angelman-syndrome-drug-results-cost-cuts/829528/)*
  * GTX-102 (apazunersen), an antisense oligonucleotide for Angelman syndrome, failed to meet its primary and secondary endpoints in a pivotal trial, demonstrating no significant efficacy difference compared to control.
  * Ultragenyx announced it will evaluate options to dispose of the program and initiate corporate cost reductions to align with its goal of reaching profitability by 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **Akeso and Summit's ivonescimab beats Keytruda in overall survival for PD-L1+ NSCLC** — *[BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/akeso-summit-cancer-drug-ivonescimab-confirms-lung-cancer-survival-benefit/829538/)* / *[X / @JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2095540178244776288)*
  * Updated trial data from the Phase 3 Harmoni-2 trial in Chinese patients demonstrated a statistically significant overall survival benefit for the PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab compared to Merck's Keytruda (pembrolizumab) in first-line NSCLC, with full data accepted as a late-breaker presentation at WCLC 2026 on September 15.
  * An abstract for the 2nd-line Phase 3 Harmoni study (PDUFA target date November 14) confirms that overall survival figures have moved into nominally positive territory.
  * While US registration will require readout from an ongoing global Phase 3 trial expected in 2028, the findings strengthen support for ivonescimab as a potential first-line treatment regimen.

* **Meta-analysis challenges benefit of adding chemotherapy to ICIs in high-expression PD-L1 NSCLC** — *[medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.01.26361919)*
  * A re-analysis of 24 Phase 3 trials controlling for immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) agent heterogeneity revealed no overall survival benefit when adding chemotherapy to ICI monotherapy in patients with PD-L1 TPS ≥ 50%.
  * Findings suggest survival gains attributed to chemoimmunotherapy in previous pooled analyses were driven by cross-agent baseline differences rather than true chemotherapy synergy.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **FDA approves Ionis's Zanvastro as first disease-modifying drug for Alexander disease** — *[FDA Press Release](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-treat-alexander-disease)*
  * The FDA approved Zanvastro (zilganersen) injection to treat pediatric and adult patients with Alexander disease, making it the first approved therapy to target the underlying GFAP protein aggregation in this neurological disorder.
  * The treatment was registered as entry #37 on the FDA's 2026 Novel Drug Approvals list.

* **FDA clarifies Phase 1 IND CMC flexibilities to streamline clinical entries** — *[FDA](http://www.fda.gov/industry/phase-1-investigational-new-drug-ind-navigator/phase-1-ind-chemistry-manufacturing-and-controls-flexibilities)*
  * The FDA published updated guidance clarifying the baseline Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) requirements for first-in-human Phase 1 IND filings.
  * By permitting deferral of non-critical CMC data to later development phases, the agency projects sponsors can reduce early-stage IND preparation timelines by up to 12 months.

* **FDA issues RFI to advance regulatory pathways for botanical drug products** — *[FDA Press Release](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-seeks-public-input-advance-development-botanical-drug-products)*
  * The agency released a Request for Information seeking public and industry input on standardizing regulatory review, characterization, and quality control for complex, multi-component plant-derived therapeutics.

* **FDA issues EUA for Capstar to prevent and treat New World screwworm in pets** — *[FDA Press Release](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-issues-emergency-use-authorization-drugs-prevent-and-treat-new-world-screwworm-dogs-and-cats)*
  * The FDA issued an Emergency Use Authorization expansion for Capstar (nitenpyram) tablets and its generic equivalent to allow both prevention and treatment of New World screwworm infestations in eligible dogs and cats.

* **[Biotech]** **Liquidia receives Fast Track designation for YUTREPIA in SSc-RP** — *[X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2095474711048122654)*
  * The FDA granted Fast Track designation to YUTREPIA (inhaled treprostinil) for the treatment of Raynaud's phenomenon secondary to systemic sclerosis (SSc-RP).
  * Liquidia plans to initiate RE-WARM, a Phase 2a dose-finding study of YUTREPIA in SSc-RP, in Q4 to target an estimated US addressable market of ~30,000 moderate-to-severe patients.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **GSK commits up to $1.3B for Hutchmed's EGFR/KRAS-targeted conjugate** — *[BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/gsk-hutchmed-egfr-kras-cancer-drug-deal-china/829542/)*
  * GSK licensed global rights (excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau) to Hutchmed's HMPL-A830 for $110 million upfront plus up to $1.19 billion in milestone payments and royalties.
  * HMPL-A830 is an antibody-targeted therapeutic conjugate combining an EGFR-directed antibody with a small-molecule KRAS inhibitor payload, set to enter Phase 1 trials this year.

* **[Biotech]** **Superluminal Medicines raises $60M Series B to advance AI-designed MC4R agonist** — *[BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/superluminal-medicines-obesity-ai-drug-discovery-series-b/829552/)*
  * Superluminal Medicines secured $60 million in Series B funding to take its lead small-molecule MC4R agonist into Phase 1 clinical testing by the end of 2026.
  * The candidate targets rare genetic forms of obesity, including Bardet-Biedl syndrome and hypothalamic obesity, using an AI platform designed for GPCR target selection.

## Public Health & Policy

* **Real-world EHR study demonstrates heterogeneous clinical benefit of PCV20 in seniors** — *[medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.31.26361811)*
  * A longitudinal cohort study of 787,538 adults aged ≥65 years observed an overall real-world effectiveness of 16.5% for the 20-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV20) against pneumonia hospitalization.
  * Machine-learning stratification showed that clinical benefit was concentrated in high-risk subsets, whereas the 60% of patients with the lowest baseline risk showed no statistically significant reduction in hospitalization.

**Worth watching:** Full Phase 3 Harmoni-2 overall survival readout for Summit/Akeso's ivonescimab at WCLC 2026 on September 15.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - ['Creatine directly causes Cancer Metastasis' - Multiple Studies](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tcMgHncZVIw) -- Physionic
        - Explores mechanistic research suggesting creatine can promote cancer metastasis through the activation of the Smad2/3 signaling pathway.
        - Evaluates observational human data linking circulating plasma metabolites and dietary creatine intake to cancer risks across population datasets.
        - Reviews clinical evidence from double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trials examining creatine supplementation in patients with cancer anorexia and weight loss syndrome.
    - [Oracle Tried to Sell an AI Product That Didn’t Exist Yet?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VS8iwzm5-YQ) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Features commentary by Bailey Morgan on an unusual product demonstration conducted by Oracle.
        - Highlights Oracle's rush to market an AI copilot designed for clinical chart review in healthcare.
        - Points out that the AI copilot product showcased during the sales pitch was not actually functional or ready for launch.
- Pure Science
    - [What Is Math For in the Age of AI? - Live from ICM 2026 | PODCAST: The Joy of Why](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mv7_b3xgFz8) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Recorded live at the International Congress of Mathematicians (ICM 2026), hosts Steven Strogatz and Janna Levin discuss AI's expanding role in mathematics with guests Akshay Venkatesh, Ravi Vakil, and Alex Kontorovich.
        - Examines milestone achievements such as AlphaProof at the IMO and AI solving Erdős problems, analyzing whether mathematical proofs serve as human storytelling beyond pure automated computation.
        - Addresses the practical impacts of AI on mathematics education and research, including "double-peak" test score trends, open-source tool access, and the role of human intuition in discovery.
    - [The Strange Geometry of Hyperbolic Surfaces](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ACBc7fxmIlM) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Highlights a new mathematical proof that extends the late Maryam Mirzakhani’s foundational work on hyperbolic surfaces.
        - Proves that a vast majority of hyperbolic surfaces possess a specific, significant geometric property.
        - Advances the theoretical understanding of the complex geometry and dynamics governing exotic hyperbolic shapes.
- Other
    - [How old is the Earth?: Crash Course Geology #17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mIIJd66Ycr8) -- CrashCourse
        - Defines geologic time and explains how scientists reconstruct the long-term history of Earth.
        - Examines key geological evidence used to date the planet, including banded iron deposits, fossil records, and radiometric dating of meteorites.
        - Summarizes how scientists determined the age of Earth and what these methods reveal about planetary evolution.
